title: Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model
description: TabPFN learns a tabular prediction algorithm from synthetic datasets and achieves strong classification and regression results on small real-world tables through in-context learning, with fast fitting but important limits on scale, inference latency, and reproducibility. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Noah Hollmann et al., 10.1038/s41586-024-08328-6Version of record — https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-08328-6
